principal: Government of United Republic of Tanzania
description: The registrant will organize programs/itineraries for visits by Tanzanian Government officials to the U.S.; introduce them to appropriate U.S. Government officials, members of Congress, and congressional staffers, as well as arrange appointments with representatives of the private sector and the media; host social/representational events; and engage in a dialogue on issues of interest to them with relevant individuals. Topics of particular interest would include programs of the Millennium Challenge Corporation, the Export-Import Bank, Overseas Private Investment Corporation, Trade Development Agency, and USAID, as well as the African Growth & Opportunity Act and the plans of U.S. private investors in Africa.
